text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, naproxen 250 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 363 tablets (19.5 days on hand at 18.6 daily use). Corvale General holds 251 tablets (13.6 days on hand at 18.5 daily use). The rule-based alternate manufacturer ranked first is Teva Pharmaceuticals, Inc., which is not on the FDA shortage list and supplies from ACTAVIS LABS FL INC. Additional alternates include ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC, and Ajanta Pharma USA Inc., none on the FDA shortage list, but with no plant placement identified.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include naproxen as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory at both sites provides limited days on hand. Teva Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is the preferred alternate source with an identified plant. Other alternates lack plant placement data.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate purchase from Teva Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (ACTAVIS LABS FL INC.) and place order if terms are acceptable; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to assess ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC, and Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. for viability and pricing; requires P&T committee approval before purchase.
3. Buyer to monitor daily usage and inventory levels at both sites weekly; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No action to delay purchasing review given current days on hand. No clinical dosing changes; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
